headline: Don Toliver Postpones London Gig After Co-op Live Evacuation
metaDescription: US rapper Don Toliver has postponed his London O2 show after an unknown substance caused the evacuation of 12,000 fans from a Manchester concert venue.
aiSummaryBullets: Authorities evacuated 12,000 attendees from the Co-op Live arena in Manchester following the release of an unidentified substance.
Nearly 90 people reported suffering from symptoms during the incident, with one individual requiring hospital treatment.
Don Toliver subsequently postponed a scheduled performance at the O2 arena in London due to the events in Manchester.
aiContextParagraph: A major incident was declared at the Co-op Live arena in Manchester after staff reported an unknown substance being released into the crowd during a performance by US rapper Don Toliver. The emergency prompted the immediate evacuation of approximately 12,000 concertgoers late on Sunday evening. According to official reports, nearly 90 individuals displayed symptoms consistent with exposure to the substance, with one person hospitalized. In the wake of the disturbance, the artist moved to postpone his upcoming appearance at the O2 arena in London. Local law enforcement has initiated an investigation into the nature of the substance and the circumstances surrounding the evacuation. While witnesses described the scene as distressing, authorities continue to process the impact of the event, which resulted in a widespread disruption of the planned concert schedule across two major United Kingdom venues.
whyItIsViral: The incident is highly viral due to the significant scale of the evacuation involving 12,000 people and extensive reporting from 10 international news outlets.
